project_music_style: Sparse chamber-lullaby score: soft strings, celesta or music-box colors, restrained woodwinds; warmth in love scenes, thin lonely textures at rejection and sack, luminous lift at Fairy without bombast.

scenes.score_intent: Bright gentle Christmas chime settling into quieter forgotten toy motif.
scenes.timing: Chime on stocking reveal; thin out under tissue-paper rush.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Rustling tissue paper; unwrapping parcels; muted household dinner arrival.
scenes.silence_guidance: Brief hold on forgotten Rabbit after noise peaks.
scenes.exclusions: No comedy slapstick stings; no modern holiday pop.
scenes.source_evidence: there was a great rustling of tissue paper and unwrapping of parcels

scenes.score_intent: Low wise pedal under Skin Horse; question motif for What is REAL?
scenes.timing: Enter after they settle by fender; hold soft under dialogue.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Small fire tick at fender if present; distant house hush before Nana tidy.
scenes.silence_guidance: Leave air after Sometimes and It lasts for always.
scenes.exclusions: No horror drones; no ticking clockwork dominance.
scenes.source_evidence: when they were lying side by side near the nursery fender, before Nana came to tidy the room.

scenes.score_intent: Hurry motif for Nana swoop resolving into soft acceptance as Rabbit enters arms.
scenes.timing: Staccato under hunt refusal; warm sustain on put into arms.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Cupboard door; fabric drag by ear; bed settle.
scenes.silence_guidance: Short breath after He'll do to sleep with you!
scenes.exclusions: No cruel impact hits on ear drag.
scenes.source_evidence: she dragged the Rabbit out by one ear, and put him into the Boy's arms.

scenes.timing: Bedclothes tunnel play; resolve under chin snuggle.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Whispers; bedclothes movement; night-light stillness; distant Nana supper leave.
scenes.silence_guidance: Long quiet on clasped hands sleep.
scenes.source_evidence: they had splendid games together, in whispers, when Nana had gone away to her supper and left the night-light burning on the mantelpiece.

scenes.score_intent: Open air pastoral; dew anxiety; triumphant tender cadence on He's REAL!
scenes.timing: Light day bed under garden play; thin cold on dusk lawn; swell on Boy's declaration.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Wheelbarrow; birds; dew drip; Nana apron rub; candle outdoor search.
scenes.silence_guidance: Beat of silence after He's REAL! before Rabbit happiness reaction.
scenes.source_evidence: He isn't a toy. He's REAL!

scenes.score_intent: Curious woodland texture turning exposed and thin on mockery; empty hold after flight.
scenes.timing: Ant micro-sounds into wild rabbit entry; cut score almost out on He isn't real!; hollow sustain alone.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Ant movement; soft pads; bracken sway; Boy footsteps; white-tail rush; moths later.
scenes.silence_guidance: No answer after Come back and play with me!
scenes.source_evidence: But there was no answer, only the little ants ran to and fro, and the bracken swayed gently

scenes.score_intent: Feverish low pulse; loyal stillness; clinical cold on burn order.
scenes.timing: Muted under illness; slight hope on recovery books; cut hard under doctor's Burn it.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Restless sleep talk; footsteps of strange people; continuous light room tone; open window air; adult dialogue.
scenes.silence_guidance: Rabbit stillness under bedclothes emphasized with reduced score.
scenes.source_evidence: a light burned all night and through it all the little Velveteen Rabbit lay there, hidden from sight under the bedclothes

scenes.score_intent: Bereft sparse line; single tear cadence; flower bloom luminescence; Fairy theme tender not grand.
scenes.timing: Near-silence in sack; note on tear hit ground; harmonic open on blossom; lift on flight.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Sack wriggle; night shiver cloth; distant garden quiet; flower open delicate; wing-air flight.
scenes.silence_guidance: Hold after tear falls before flower appears.
scenes.exclusions: No thunderous choir; no horror stingers.
scenes.source_evidence: And a tear, a real tear, trickled down his little shabby velvet nose and fell to the ground.

scenes.score_intent: Moon glade dance; transformation joy leaps; autumn-winter breathe; spring bittersweet recognition without full resolve.
scenes.timing: Dance ring under Fairy speech; burst on first hind-leg scratch and leaps; gentle coda on Boy's thought.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Rabbit feet on grass; bracken; later spring birds; soft peep of two rabbits.
scenes.silence_guidance: Quiet on Boy's private thought; end on unresolved soft air so he never knows.
scenes.exclusions: No triumphant fanfare that spoils withheld knowledge.
scenes.source_evidence: But he never knew that it really was his own Bunny, come back to look at the child who had first helped him to be Real.
